text:
sara-people: ALERT: Emily Carter (IC) shows as active in both RWI-US and RWI-UK payroll records for Apr-May 2026 after a duplicate hire/merge. Looks like she was paid twice for May. Need immediate remediation — potential duplicate gross and tax reporting exposure.

payroll-bot: Duplicate detection triggered: DUP-2026-330 for employee emily.carter@example.com -> records PR-US-3321 and PR-UK-778. Payments: US payroll paid 2026-05-10 ($6,000), UK payroll paid 2026-05-27 (£4,500).

tom-payroll: Confirming. I can see both active records. UK record created when manager re-onboarded via PeopleHub. US record never terminated due to pending offboarding ticket. I'll freeze any further payments to the duplicate entity.

jamal-tax: Tax implications: US payment may be subject to US federal & state withholding; UK payment subject to PAYE/NI. If employee was UK tax resident in May, US wages could create double withholding and reporting risks (W-2 + UK PAYE). Need to determine actual tax residency/date of move and whether payments were for the same work period.

oliver-gp: On it. Created task GP-2026-112 to reconcile cross-entity payments and calculate reversal or gross-up. Need employee confirmation of residency dates and bank destinations (GBP vs USD).

emily-ic: Hi all — I moved to London on 2026-04-29 and submitted relocation docs. I updated bank details to my UK account on 2026-05-02. I did accept the new UK offer. I did not intend to receive US payroll for May. Happy to sign consent for corrections.

finance: FYI cashflow: both payouts cleared. US payroll ACH cleared 2026-05-10 txn ACH-9012. UK BACS cleared 2026-05-27 ref BACS-447. We can attempt recall on US ACH (window may be passed). If unrecoverable, need GL adjustments.

legal: We'll prepare an employee acknowledgement letter and run risk review. Confirm whether any benefit deductions or employer tax credits applied twice. Also check pension contributions in the UK resulted in auto-enrolment.

hr-ops: Emily please upload proof of move (flight, lease) and confirm effective employment entity/date so we can document the change. We'll attach to the case.

tom-payroll: Action list I'm executing now: 1) Freeze PR-US-3321 recurring payments; 2) Open PAY-REV-349 to request ACH reversal from payments ops; 3) Coordinate with UK payroll to keep PR-UK-778 active and run corrective payroll entry to reflect the May pay as canonical.

jamal-tax: If we cannot reverse US withholdings, we'll need to file a W-2c to correct US reporting and coordinate with HMRC to claim relief or provide foreign tax credits. Also check state withholding (NY vs none). Document dates carefully for residency tie-breaker tests.

payroll-bot: Tickets updated: DUP-2026-330 -> linked: PAY-REV-349, GP-2026-112. Status: in progress.

finance: Payments ops attempted ACH recall on ACH-9012; status: returned code RT-05 (funds already disbursed). We can only pursue repayment from employee or pursue GL reversal. Please advise on repatriation approach.

oliver-gp: Calculating net/net exposure now. If repayment from employee is required we'll draft payroll adjustment agreements (gross-up options if needed). Also computing employer NI and employer tax deltas for UK.

emily-ic: I'm happy to repay the duplicate net amount if that's easiest. Prefer a payroll deduction plan rather than manual invoice. Also want confirmation this won't affect my visa status.

legal: Repayment via payroll deduction needs explicit signed Consent Agt. We'll draft and send. Visa note: repayment itself shouldn't affect status but we'll confirm with immigration counsel.

jamal-tax: Proposed remediation path: 1) Prefer recall; if not possible 2) UK payroll treats UK pay as primary, and US payroll issues W-2c to remove duplicate US wages and refund withholdings; 3) If refund not possible, process repayment plan via UK payroll grossed-up to cover tax delta (or net repayment with employee consent). I'll prepare a tax memo.

tom-payroll: Creating internal doc: RECON-EMP-EMC-05-2026 with breakdown. Attaching to tickets.

finance: To proceed with GL adjustments we need sign-off from FP&A and accounting. Tagging @controls. Please route an approval request with amounts and account codes.

hr-ops: Emily uploaded docs and signed acknowledgement. Sending repayment consent form via DocuSign now.

oliver-gp: After consent, I'll run a reversing payroll entry in the US entity to zero out the gross and withholdings and coordinate a net reimbursement for any residual differences. Will also ensure P60/P45 equivalents in UK are correct for records.

legal: Drafted employee repayment consent and explanatory letter; sent to Emily for signature. Also prepping internal memo for auditors.

emily-ic: Signed the DocuSign. Thanks for quick handling.

jamal-tax: I'll finalize the tax memo once I have final numbers from @oliver-gp. Target: all corrections and filings (W-2c, reclassified payroll entries) completed by 2026-08-15 to avoid year-end complexity.

sara-people: Great teamwork. I'll close out PeopleHub onboarding audit to prevent future duplicate creations and will add a new validation step for entity selection when address differs from country.

payroll-bot: Final status snapshot: DUP-2026-330 -> in progress; PAY-REV-349 -> reversal failed; GP-2026-112 -> reconciliation underway.
